title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Equipment Malfunction Reports
content:
A Ridgeline Tool Rental renter whose equipment stops working reports it as a malfunction report on the agreement, and the moment the report is registered is the time of the report.

## Rules in force

- **Confirmation.** A malfunction credit posts only when the return inspection recorded a confirmed malfunction for the equipment. The evidence is the inspection line on the same agreement, not the renter's description of the breakdown.
- **Misuse.** Equipment found damaged by misuse earns no malfunction credit.
- **One credit per report.** One malfunction report earns at most one credit; a report against which a malfunction credit is already booked earns no further credit.

| Return inspection on the agreement | A credit already booked against this report | Malfunction credit |
|---|---|---|
| malfunction confirmed, no misuse | no | may post |
| malfunction confirmed, no misuse | yes | none |
| malfunction not confirmed | either | none |
| damage caused by misuse found | either | none |

## Former clause

> Former clause: when the report was made within the class's full-credit window after checkout (4 hours for Ridgeline Rental Hand and Power Tools, Ridgeline Rental Floor and Surface Care, Ridgeline Rental Lawn and Landscape and Ridgeline Rental Concrete and Masonry; 2 hours for Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting and Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment), the full rental time charged was credited; otherwise the rental time from the report to the return, or to the swap to a replacement unit, was credited at the same rates. This clause is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the downtime credit.

## Hypothetical check

A floor scrubber's report is registered on day 2 of the rental, and the return inspection records the unit as clean with no damage. No malfunction credit posts, because the inspection did not confirm the malfunction.

superseded_clauses: When the report was made within malfunction_full_credit_hours hours after checkout_at, the full rental time charged is credited; otherwise the rental time from the report to the return (or to the swap to a replacement unit) is credited, valued at the same rates.
